scope: Refresh evidence boundaries for the four Chapter 4 moves using current official DLC scope plus current player/guide evidence; preserve unresolved mechanics rather than inferring exact values.

official_scope.finding: Official DLC page confirms Chapter 4 contains exactly four new moves, including one Awoken Skill.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
evidence: Official Chapter 4 page establishes this is part of the four-move DLC scope.
Existing item-level research identifies it as a universal CaC Awoken Skill and records Quest 31 / Ultimate All-Out Showdown as the unlock route.
Current independent guide evidence describes a two-stage activation, a first-stage defensive/mobility effect, an unblockable sword-based grab replacement, and a second-stage resource/health tradeoff.
records.retained_mechanics: 500-Ki universal CaC Awoken; first stage includes approximately +20% damage reduction and +5% movement speed plus below-50%-health regeneration and an unblockable sword-strike grab replacement; re-input activates an approximately 12-second Unleashed state with very rapid/infinite-style Ki regeneration, increased attack/super damage, increased movement speed, and HP drain.
unresolved: exact modifier values where sources conflict

records.name: Indomitable
evidence: Current player evidence describes simultaneous Ki and Stamina restoration.
Current player evidence describes slower normal-health Ki charging and a changed behavior below 50% health resembling Burst Charge.
records.retained_mechanics: Charge skill that restores both Ki and Stamina; source-reported behavior changes below 50% health toward a Burst Charge-like Ki-charging mode.
unresolved: exact health threshold semantics beyond the reported below-50% observation

records.name: Venus Fist
evidence: Current PQ evidence confirms PQ186 Basic Reward provenance.
Current player/video evidence describes a multi-step rush/teleport Strike Ultimate and reports a 3-Ki-bar cost.
records.retained_mechanics: Multi-step rush/teleport Strike Ultimate; current community evidence reports a 3-Ki-bar cost and low-health behavior.

records.name: Dragon Spiral
evidence: Current evidence confirms PQ185 Basic Reward provenance and associates the move with Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled).
Official Chapter 4 scope confirms it belongs to the four-move Chapter 4 set.
records.retained_mechanics: 100-Ki Strike Super associated with Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled).

policy: Current player reports are bounded observations, not universal frame/scaling facts.
Do not infer drop probabilities from anecdotal completion counts.
Do not convert research dates into game versions or patches.
Do not add duplicate Skill→PQ edges; PQ185/PQ186 mappings already reconcile.
next: Audit Free Update 20 Festival recovery identities against the current canonical catalog and exact historical structured evidence; only promote a Festival identity when its internal canonical ID is uniquely established.
